title: Token-level Data Selection for Safe LLM Fine-tuning
authors_zh: Yanping Li, Zhening Liu, Zijian Li, Zehong Lin, Jun Zhang
paper_type_zh: 安全微调的词元级数据选择论文（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 研究安全微调、训练数据清洗和安全—效用权衡的读者。
one_line: TOSS masks unsafe response tokens before SFT using a loss-difference signal from safety and utility reference models.
TOSS 依据安全与效用参考模型的损失差，在 SFT 前掩掉不安全回复词元。
why: It makes the connection between a data object and its training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: It changes how a training record, selection decision, or reward signal is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Safety-aligned models are often fine-tuned on mixed instruction data to gain new task ability, but that process can weaken the refusal behavior learned during alignment. Whole-example filtering is a blunt remedy: a response may contain a short unsafe span together with useful explanations, or it may be removed entirely even though most of its supervision is harmless. Conversely, retaining the full response can still send gradients through the tokens most likely to undermine safety.

The paper asks whether selection can be moved from examples to target tokens. TOSS compares how a safety-degraded reference model and a utility-oriented reference model assign loss to each response token, then uses their difference to decide which targets should stop contributing to supervised fine-tuning. The aim is to retain as much useful custom data as possible while changing the exact training signal that reaches the model.

经过安全对齐的模型常会在混合指令数据上继续微调以获得新任务能力，但这一过程可能削弱对齐阶段学到的拒答行为。整例过滤是一种粗糙补救：一条回复可能只含有很短的不安全片段，却也包含有用解释；也可能因而被整条删掉，尽管大多数监督无害。反过来，保留完整回复仍会让梯度经过最可能破坏安全性的词元。

论文追问能否把选择从样本层面移动到目标词元层面。TOSS 比较安全退化参考模型和效用导向参考模型为每个回复词元赋予的损失，再利用两者差异决定哪些目标不再参与监督微调。目标是在尽可能保留有用自定义数据的同时，改变真正传递到模型的训练信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TOSS changes the training record from an undifferentiated instruction-response pair into the same pair plus a per-token loss mask. The text need not be deleted from the dataset, and the model can still read the response prefix during teacher forcing, but masked target positions contribute no supervised gradient. This makes the unit of curation a token-level learning event rather than an entire prompt or response.

Its selection signal is the loss difference between two reference models that represent competing desiderata: preserving safe behavior and retaining task utility. Tokens that look especially favored by the safety-degraded model relative to the utility reference are ranked as higher risk and masked globally. TOSS-Pro then refines the harmful reference with selected high-risk examples, making the risk model progressively more tailored to the harmful behavior the method seeks to suppress.

TOSS 将训练记录从未加区分的指令—回复对改为同一对文本加上逐词元损失掩码。文本不必从数据集中删除，模型在教师强制时仍可读取回复前缀，但被掩掉的目标位置不贡献监督梯度。因此，整理的单位不再是整条提示或回复，而是词元级的学习事件。

它的选择信号是两个代表相互竞争目标的参考模型之间的损失差：一方代表保留安全行为，另一方代表保留任务效用。相对于效用参考模型，安全退化模型特别偏好的词元会被排为更高风险，并在全局范围内掩掉。TOSS-Pro 随后用选出的高风险样本改进有害参考模型，使风险模型逐步更贴合该方法希望抑制的有害行为。

title: Method
方法
html:
The procedure first constructs a safety-degraded reference and a utility-oriented reference, then computes each target token's loss under both models. Their difference becomes the token-risk score, allowing target positions across the whole training pool to be ranked together instead of making a separate keep-or-drop judgment for each response. The global top-risk cutoff makes the masking ratio an explicit design choice rather than a side effect of whole-example filtering.

The selected high-risk tokens are masked before LoRA supervised fine-tuning, while lower-risk targets remain available for learning. TOSS-Pro repeats the harmful-reference refinement with selected examples and reruns the scoring process. The reported setup draws from REDORCA, including 90K SlimOrca instances and 22K harmful Anthropic Red Teaming instances; official code and checkpoints are public, but the method does not release a new standalone dataset or make its mask a universal safety label.

该流程先构造安全退化参考模型和效用导向参考模型，再计算每个目标词元在两个模型下的损失。两者的差成为词元风险分数，使整个训练池中的目标位置可以共同排序，而不是为每条回复分别做保留或丢弃判断。全局最高风险截断使掩码比例成为显式设计选择，而非整例过滤的副作用。

被选出的高风险词元会在 LoRA 监督微调前被掩掉，较低风险的目标仍可用于学习。TOSS-Pro 用选中的样本重复改进有害参考模型，再重新运行打分过程。报告的设置使用 REDORCA，其中包括 90K 条 SlimOrca 样本和 22K 条有害的 Anthropic Red Teaming 样本；官方代码和检查点已公开，但方法没有发布新的独立数据集，也没有把掩码称为通用安全标签。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
At the same 10% discard ratio on Llama-3-8B, TOSS-Pro scores 88.85 on Anthropic HH, 93.79 on HEx-PHI, and 68.85 on SlimOrca; SEAL scores 58.20, 68.83, and 57.41. These are GPT-4o win rates against standard SFT.

The paper also transfers the selected mask to Llama-3.2 models with the same tokenizer. This supports the stated safety setting, not a guarantee for every custom-data distribution.

在 Llama-3-8B 上、相同 10% 丢弃比例下，TOSS-Pro 在 Anthropic HH、HEx-PHI 和 SlimOrca 上为 88.85、93.79 和 68.85；SEAL 为 58.20、68.83 和 57.41。这些数值是相对标准 SFT 的 GPT-4o 胜率。

论文还把选出的掩码迁移到共享词表的 Llama-3.2 模型。这支持所述安全设置，而不是对每个自定义数据分布的保证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Sample-level safety filtering chooses whole responses. TOSS changes the selection decision to response tokens and makes reference-model loss difference the signal.

TOSS-Pro adds progressive refinement of the safety-degraded reference; LoRA and the general safety–utility goal are not new. Ordinary safety evaluation is excluded because it does not decide which tokens enter updates.

样本级安全过滤选择整条回复。TOSS 把选择决策改为回复词元，并以参考模型损失差作为信号。

TOSS-Pro 新增安全退化参考的渐进改进；LoRA 和一般性的安全—效用目标并不新。普通安全评测被排除，因为它不决定哪些词元进入更新。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Risk depends on the two reference models, the chosen 10% discard ratio, and a harm taxonomy; different tokenizers can change the mask. The GPT-4o judging setup needs human or task-specific audit before deployment.
风险依赖两个参考模型、设定的 10% 丢弃比例和有害性分类体系；不同词表会改变掩码。GPT-4o 判别设置在部署前需要人工或任务专用审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it when mixed custom data must preserve task utility while protecting a safe base model. Build defensible reference subsets, compare with an equal-ratio sample filter, and evaluate both safety and utility. Do not use it without a meaningful safety reference set.
当质量混合的自定义数据既要保留任务效用、又要保护安全基模型时可使用它。建立可信参考子集，与相同丢弃比例的样本过滤比较，并同时评估安全与效用。没有有意义的安全参考集时不要使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The record is unchanged but its loss mask changes; two references score token risk; top-risk tokens are masked; TOSS-Pro refines the harmful reference; and the representative 93.79 HEx-PHI result is a GPT-4o win rate.
记录不变，但损失掩码改变；两个参考模型给词元风险打分；掩掉最高风险词元；TOSS-Pro 改进有害参考；代表性的 HEx-PHI 93.79 是 GPT-4o 胜率。
